clinical_intent: I need to create an institutional protocol for brachytherapy dose reporting. The protocol should include: (1) ICRU 89 dose reporting requirements for cervical cancer, (2) GTV, CTV, and OAR dose reporting specifications, (3) DVH reporting requirements, (4) dose-volume parameter definitions and calculations, (5) cumulative dose reporting for fractionated treatments, and (6) template for brachytherapy dose report. Please provide a comprehensive reporting protocol with template.
